grades.main_gap: Both load-bearing results are explicitly open: Theorem L (lower bound, Liu's geometric strategy, n>=3) and Lemma X1/Theorem X (upper bound when min Delta_k<0). Only the greedy reduction and special cases are proved.
grades.notes: Correct conjectured answer 2^n/(2^{n+1}-1), a proved greedy-claiming reduction, counting lemma, upper bound in two regimes, and n<=2 verified. But both directions of the min-max are unproved for general n; the core difficulty is absent.
